nom: BYOMA Blemish Acne Treatment Spot Paste

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and appreciate the gentle formula, including several who used it on children or teenagers.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin who gets recurring pimples reports noticeable improvement in blemishes within a day using this as a nighttime treatment.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the spot paste visibly shrinks and helps dry out blemishes within one to three days, including some describing it as effective on hormonal or cystic pimples, though a number of reviewers saw little to no improvement even with regular use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report reduced redness and inflammation around blemishes, often within a day, with several noting the swelling goes down even before the pimple is fully gone.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers highlight that, unlike other spot treatments they've used, this one does not dry out or irritate the skin surrounding the blemish.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers note it also helps fade the look of post-acne marks with continued use.

aspects.libelle: Tinted, clay-toned paste is visible on skin
Takes a while to fully dry
Can double as light concealer for fair skin tones
Affordable price for a targeted treatment

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First things first, I am not a fan. I gave it a bit of hope but just no. It is a no for me. I am more of a benzoyl peroxide girl. Salicylic acid does nothing for me. And it is only 2%. It is a colored cream. Like a beige color. And you just apply with your finger. I do like the packaging and it is very percise tip. So not a lot comes out. But overall this product did nothing. I feel luke I have had my acné for a month now. Like they are still there.

extraits.titre: Somewhat helps calm down scent inflammation
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The ingredients seem fine for this blemish spot treatment, it smells and feels a bit minty. It reminds me of the volcanic face masks as it has the same colour. It even has diatomaceous earth, which is interesting, I never see that in products. The squeeze bottle is easy to apply but I think the consistency makes it harder to be super precise in spot treatments. It doesn't burn my skin, which is great as I have sensitive skin and rosacea. I have used this plenty of times for the occasional outbreak, but have noticed that it usually somewhat decreases the redness of acne but doesn't fully make it go away. Its an very portable product so you can use it many different places but it takes a while to fully dry. I do forget it's on my face and end up smearing it though! Overall, it helps with the redness/inflammation from outbreaks but it isn't a product that makes it go away 100%. It just somewhat decreased that.

extraits.titre: Didn't work great for my hormonal acne
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have pretty bad hormonal acne. I used this product for 2 weeks after cleansing and before bed. I don't think it did much, it wiped off as soon as I laid down to sleep. I probably would rather wear this during the day when I'm home as a mask to see if it helps. The texture or scent didn't bother my or my sensitive skin at all

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had a great experience with this product, I tried it on a breakout that was particularly gnarly, and it took care of it within 3 days and avoided scarring. It didn't sting unless there was a bit of an open wound. Redness was significantly reduced after use as well as pain. This is definitely an acne treatment to use overnight, because the clay content gives it an opaque beige tone. Would definitely recommend for folks with sensitive skin that still need to take care of their breakouts!

extraits.titre: Could be good for the right skin / dry
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lots of beneficial ingredients, and I do love an explanation of ingredients list! However, the soybean oil is potentially comedogenic - and DEFINITELY so with skin like mine. Not that I know how to formulate products, but I wish they could have found a way to leave out that oil and some of the other potentially irritating/pore-clogging/not fungal acne safe ingredients. So I had some breaking out but if you don't have acne or oily prone skin, you could be totally fine.

I applied at night because of the tint. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product exchange for my review. I have combination skin and tend to get annoying pimples during the month. I am happy to be able to try this acne treatment spot paste by Byoma. I use it at night after my cleansing routine. It has a light scent and a thick texture. It takes about 5 minutes to dry completely. There was noticeable improvement on my blemishes. They were reduced in size and starting to go away the next day. I'd definitely recommend this paste to anyone that wants quick results to any pimple on your face. It didn't cause any irritation or dry out my skin either!
